---
title: "Dr. Smith appointed to NAM Consensus Study"
author: "Steven M. Smith"
date: "2025-03-26"
categories: [news]
image: "Steve-Smith.jpg"
---

Dr. Smith was appointed as a member of the [National Academy of Medicine](https://nam.edu/) consensus study on [Clinical Preventive Services for Addressing Cardiovascular Disease Risk to Reduce Pregnancy-related Deaths Among Women](https://www.nationalacademies.org/our-work/clinical-preventive-services-for-addressing-cardiovascular-disease-risk-to-reduce-pregnancy-related-deaths-among-women). 

The College of Pharmacy has a brief write-up, which can be found [here](https://pharmacy.ufl.edu/2025/03/26/dr-steven-smith-named-to-national-academies-of-sciences-engineering-and-medicine-committee/).
